entry.title: Resolution 516 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO ENTER INTO NEGOTIATIONS FOR THE ACQUISITION OF LANDS OR CONSERVATION EASEMENTS FOR ALL OR A PORTION OF THE PROPERTIES IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEYS: 1-4-002:002, 017, 042, 047, 048, 058, 065, 072, 080, 082, 085, 092, AND 100, ALSO KNOWN AS KUMUKAHI, SITUATED IN THE AHUPUAʻA OF KULA, DISTRICT OF PUNA, UTILIZING THE PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES

The County seeks to acquire approximately 1,967.96 acres of land that is listed as priority number three in the 2025 Annual Report of the Public Access, Open Space, and Natural Resources Preservation Commission.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 516-26, Draft 2; adopts LAAC-039 - 05/05/26
